features.description: List of Rex feature flags to enable in the Rexfile, e.g., autodie, template_ng, 1.4.

default_user.description: The default username to use for SSH connections when not overridden by server-specific settings.

default_password.description: The default password for authentication. Leave empty or use private keys in production.

default_private_key.description: Path to the default private key file for SSH authentication.

enable_autodie.description: If true, enables the 'autodie' feature flag, causing Rex to die on failed commands.

enable_template_ng.description: If true, enables the 'template_ng' feature flag for the new template engine.

group_name.description: The name of the default server group to define.

server_list.description: List of server hostnames or IPs belonging to the default group.

servers.description: List of individual server configurations with specific attributes. Items are flat maps with keys: name, user, password, private_key.
